purpose: Development-only information-preservation repair of the fixed sparse-kernel readout; no heldout efficacy claim

common_transform.fit_scope: Concatenate train_x0 and train_x1; common eight-coordinate mean and population standard deviation; never fit on development

native.pure_native40: Actual unchanged sparse_tick via pinned FFI, two transformed 8D events, final20 activations+20 eligibility coordinates divided byQ24
native.raw16_native24: First16 coordinates are original untransformed [x0,x1], preserving all raw public inputs; remaining24 are native40 coordinates with highest training population variance; descending variance and ascending original index tie-break; selection never reads labels or development

history.raw16_rff24: First16 coordinates are original untransformed [x0,x1]; remaining24 are the frozen Fourier features defined below

fourier_features.weights: numpy.default_rng(271029).normal(size=(16,12))/sqrt(16); the same fixed matrix for every transform and seed
fourier_features.input: For each common transform, concatenate [u0,u1], fit its16-coordinate mean/std ontraining rows only, standardize using max(std,1e-6); no additional clipping
fourier_features.features: [cos(z@W),sin(z@W)]/sqrt(12), ordered12cos then12sin; no phase, bandwidth, frequency, or feature selection tuning

head.family: 41x5 ridge with train-only feature standardization max(std,1e-6), unpenalized intercept, same existing V1 prediction rule
head.selection: Maximize development mean recorded net return separately within each representation and seed; family order then transform order then alpha order breaks exact ties; no development refit
head.family_reporting: Also report best pure-native, hybrid-native, original-history and Fourier-history heads separately; do not attribute a hybrid improvement to the old pure-state representation

baselines: fixed action maximizing training mean and reused on development
best fixed action maximizing development mean
per-row oracle, diagnostic upper benchmark only
metrics: all144 trained coefficient matrices and all normalizers
train/development net return and oracle regret
actual per-row selected actions and condition decomposition
native coordinate variance/ranking and Fourier transform identity
40D feature ranks and exact constant columns
actual native ticks and shared extraction wall time; per-family feature construction and fit wall time
feature_budget_scope: Equal head coefficients and equal24-candidate development search opportunities, not identical transform cost or total stored constants; record native coordinate selectors and Fourier weights/normalizers separately
source_correlation: 384development rows are96sourcepairs under4conditions; seed models and conditions are paired. This analysis reports descriptive development statistics, no row-iid inference or p-values.
existing_outcome_reuse: V1 training/development returns already include declared action charges; no new generator call, target scoring, or audit-observer access
exclusions: Never open V1/V2test orretention outputs; do not modify frozen pilot, fitbank, auditbank, or scientific gates; no production activation
preservation: Freeze this protocol and actual source hashes before fitting; save all144 heads, their predictions/actions, input/feature hashes and timing. Retain adverse seeds and both pure/hybrid families.
interpretation: A favorable result is a selected-development candidate for prospective validation. An unfavorable or mixed result preserves the blocker. Neither outcome changes prior confirmatory results or proves neuron-specific superiority.
